title: Robot bounded in circle
statementMd:
A robot at (0, 0) facing north repeats the instruction string forever (`G` go forward 1, `L` turn left, `R` turn right). Return whether it stays within a bounded circle.

**Example:** `is_robot_bounded("GGLLGG")` returns `true`.
hints: After one cycle it is bounded if it is back at the origin or not facing north.
